# Description

This form provides for the reporting of estimates of retained catches in live weight equivalent (metric tonnes; t) for the IOTC species, common sharks, and other bycatch species. Reporting of quarterly estimates is voluntary and recommended to assess seasonality of the retained catches. For each stratum, the data coverage – i.e., the percentage (%) of amount of fish sampled – derived from the coverage type must be reported to assess the representativeness and quality of the estimates.

Click [here](./Form-1RC.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form 1RC, or [return](./index.html) to the list of all IOTC statistical data reporting forms.

# Data Content

Total live weight of retained catches by species, along with information on the value (%) and type of sampling coverage used for the estimations by  quarter if available, year, fleet, fishery, retain reason and IOTC main area.

# Stratification

## General Information

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Reporting year | M | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer	| e.g., `1996` |
| Reporting entity | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | String | **Code** from [Entities](#entities) |
| Flag state | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the country registration of the fishing vessels | String | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) |

## Main Data Elements

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Quarter | O | Fishing time period | Integer | **0**: Jan-Dec; **1**: Jan-Mar; **2**: Apr-Jun; **3**: Jul-Sep; **4**: Oct-Dec |
| Fishery | M | [IOTC fishery](../guidelines/#Fisheries) used to define fishing practices, which emerge from the combination of fishery purposes, area of operation, fishing vessels' size, gear and gear configuration, and target species | **Code** from [Fisheries](#Fisheries) | e.g., `PS-DF[IN]TR` | 
| IOTC area | M | Main IOTC areas | **Code** from [IOTC main areas](#IOTCareasMain) | e.g., `` |
| Retain reason | M | Reason for retaining the catch onboard | **Code** from [Reasons for retaining](#retainReasons) | e.g., | 
| Species | M | Species caught and retained | **Code** from [Species](#allSpecies) | e.g., `` | 

## Original Data

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Original data type  | M | Preliminary/final status of the data | String | **Code** from [Types of data](#types) |
| Original data source  | M | Source of information | String | **Code** from [Retained catches data sources](#dataSourcesRC) |
| Original data processing | M  | Processing applied to the data | String | **Code** from [Retained catches data processings](#dataProcessingsRC) |
| Source coverage type  | M | Variable used for data coverage | String | **Code** from [Types of coverage](#coverageTypes) |

# Reporting Metadata

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Liaison officer full name | M | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | String | e.g., `John Doe` |
| Liaison officer email	 | M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | e.g., `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | e.g., `Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | e.g., `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | e.g., `1996-03-27` |
| Submission date | O | Date of submission of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | e.g., `1997-03-21` |

# Reporting Deadlines

- **Longline fisheries**: 30 June (preliminary), 30 December (final)
- **Surface fisheries**: 30 June (final)
- **Coastal fisheries**: 30 June (final)
